name: Arunachal Pradesh

topAttractions.name: Tawang Monastery
topAttractions.description: The largest monastery in India, built in 1681 by Merag Lama, a Tibetan Buddhist monk.

topAttractions.name: Sela Pass
topAttractions.description: A high-altitude mountain pass at 13,700 feet, connecting Tawang to other parts of Arunachal Pradesh.

topAttractions.name: Itanagar
topAttractions.description: The capital city of Arunachal Pradesh, known for its scenic beauty and the Ita Fort, a 19th-century fort built by the Ahom kingdom.

bestTimeToVisit: October to November or March to May, when the weather is mild and pleasant.
culturalFact: Arunachal Pradesh is home to the Nyishi tribe, who are known for their expertise in traditional crafts like woodcarving and bamboo work.

hiddenGem.name: Dirang Valley
hiddenGem.description: A picturesque valley surrounded by mountains, known for its scenic beauty and trekking opportunities.

relatedFestival: Losar, the Tibetan New Year, celebrated by the Buddhist community in Arunachal Pradesh.
passportTieIn: If you have stamps from Tawang or Itanagar, you might be interested in visiting the other northeastern states of India, like Meghalaya or Nagaland!
